# SJD TRADEHOUSE

> SJD TRADEHOUSE is a merchant export house based in Rohtak, India, sourcing, testing, and shipping essential oils, oleoresins, spices, nuts, dried fruits, grains and millets, powders, and eco disposables to wholesale buyers, formulators, and flavour houses worldwide. Every consignment ships with a full documentation set (COA, TDS, SDS, Certificate of Origin, Phytosanitary Certificate, Commercial Invoice & Packing List, Bill of Lading, and an Allergen/Non-GMO Declaration).

## Products

31 core SKUs across eight categories. Full details at %SITE_URL%/products, or view an individual product at %SITE_URL%/product/<id>.

Available now:

- Dried Fruits: Medjool Dates (Egypt), Turkish Figs, Turkish Apricots, Dried Mulberry (Afghanistan)
- Nuts: Afghani Mamra (Afghan Mamra almonds), Afghani Walnuts (Afghan walnuts)
- Grains & Millets: Pearl Millet (Bajra), Ragi (Finger Millet), Maize (Corn), Basmati Rice
- Spices: Black Pepper (Whole), Dried Red Chilli, Cinnamon, Cloves (Whole), Coriander Seeds, Nutmeg
- Powders: Ginger Powder
- Eco Disposables: Bagasse Plates, Sal Leaf Plates

Coming soon (not yet available to quote):

- Essential Oils: Eucalyptus Oil, Clove Bud Oil, Lemongrass Oil, Citronella Oil
- Oleoresins: Black Pepper Oleoresin
- Spices: Saffron, Cumin Seed
- Nuts: Cashew Kernels
- Powders: Guar Gum Powder, Onion Powder, Potato Powder
- Eco Disposables: Areca Leaf Plates
